# ContractAI Agent Harness Observability

ContractAI is a local contract intelligence workflow upgraded from one-shot extraction to a traceable, evaluable, human-reviewable Agent Harness.

It demonstrates how an enterprise AI task can move beyond a single model call and become a workflow with trace, evaluation, failure taxonomy, human review, token usage, and local-first storage.

This repository is a showcase package. Sensitive source code, API keys, private test contracts, and internal business data are not included.

## 1. Why this project

Contract processing is a high-risk enterprise workflow. A useful AI product cannot stop at "extract fields once"; it needs review boundaries, traceable steps, quality signals, failure recovery, and delivery-ready outputs.

ContractAI uses a local-first desktop workflow to explore how contract extraction can become an Agent Harness instead of a one-shot model call.

## 2. Workflow

```text
Upload Contract
→ Document AI Pipeline
→ Agent Harness Loop
→ Human Review
→ Structured Contract Ledger / Export
```

The workflow is designed around practical contract operations: upload, parse, inspect, correct, save, search, export, and back up.

## 3. Agent Harness Observability

The v1.1 showcase focuses on the system around the model:

- Trace for task lifecycle and execution steps
- Evaluation for output quality and field completeness
- Failure Taxonomy for classifying and recovering from common failures
- Human Review before ledger save/export
- Token Usage for cost and runtime observability
- Local-first Storage for sensitive workflow data

## 4. Trace

Trace captures key task events without exposing private contract content.

Example trace checkpoints:

- Authorization check
- File path validation
- Text extraction
- Model request
- JSON parsing
- Fallback status
- Result return

## 5. Evaluation

Evaluation summarizes whether the model output is usable enough for review:

- Field completeness
- Missing required fields
- Amount validity
- Line item count
- Confidence level
- Human edit status

## 6. Failure Taxonomy

Failure types make the workflow easier to debug, recover, and improve.

Example categories:

- `key_missing`
- `pdf_no_text`
- `api_timeout`
- `json_parse_failed`
- `path_invalid`
- `fallback_used`

## 7. Human Review

ContractAI does not treat AI extraction as final truth. The human review step allows users to inspect and correct extracted fields and line items before saving to the ledger or exporting to Excel.

## 8. Token Usage

Token usage is part of the harness signal, not just a billing detail. It helps evaluate cost, latency, fallback rate, and whether a workflow can become a repeatable product.

Tracked signals may include:

- Prompt tokens
- Completion tokens
- Total tokens
- Model latency
- Inference mode

## 9. Local-first Security

The desktop workflow is designed around local storage for contracts, traces, evaluations, templates, and backups.

Sensitive source code, API keys, private test contracts, full prompt text, contract full text, and raw model responses are not included in this public showcase.
